place.title: Ata Kebab Meze
place.address: Kalkan, Şehitler Cd. no:21, 07960 Kaş/Antalya, Türkiye

reviews.snippet: Süper döner ve et şiş yiyebilirsiniz. Muhteşem
Yemekler cok guzeldi, her sey harikaydi serviste gayet hizliydi. Tavsiye ediyorum.
Excellent food and service. A pleasure given the amount of ‘international’ menus in the centre of  Kalkan
top restaurant nettes Personal frisches essen und nicht zu voll

Most of the restaurants in Kalkan charged extortionate prices for wine. Ata was near to our apartment and wine looked reasonably priced at 700 tl. We went there on our first night, 15th April. Main man front of house is very attentive and professional. We ordered a yoghurt dip and lahmacun to start but an array of Meze on the house was also provided so only ordered one large chicken wings to share to follow. Plenty of food for two. Everything was very tasty.
The bill came to 1530 tl.
We returned a couple of days later to find the wine was no longer on the menu. On checking we were told the menu had changed for the tourist season (more expensive). Asked about the wine and told we would be charged the same. This time just took the complementary Meze with two medium main courses: chicken shish and meatballs, again could not fault the food. Sad that tourists are to be fleeced though and that the price of the wine is no longer publicly displayed.

Wir hatten einen fantastischen Abend im ATA Kebap in Kaş. Das Essen war einfach super lecker – besonders die Pide und der İskender Kebap (siehe Foto) waren frisch und perfekt gewürzt.
Was den Besuch aber wirklich besonders gemacht hat, war die sehr nette Bedienung. Man fühlt sich sofort willkommen. Zudem ist das Preis-Leistungs-Verhältnis für die Qualität und die Portionsgröße unschlagbar.
Wer in Kaş ist, sollte hier unbedingt vorbeischauen!
Sehr zu empfehlen!
